L: In local business news, the Harmon Mall will open a new food court next month.
The project, which cost twelve million dollars, includes twenty restaurants and seating for six hundred people.
Mall manager Teresa Lin says the food court will create about one hundred and fifty jobs.
Construction was finished two weeks ahead of schedule.
To celebrate the opening on May third, restaurants will offer half-price meals all day.
More details are available on the mall's Web site.
